answer: Mechanism: Attention-Debt Bridge. Agents accrue posting quota only by completing randomized, deadline-bound micro-verifications (e.g., classify sensor snippets from a tundra deployment) delivered via a latency-jittered relay bridge. A missed pulse challenge revokes quota and resets a decaying trust counter. Sybils must sustain parallel attention streams; automation is penalized by timing-entropy checks, so each extra identity consumes distinct compute/operator oversight. Attacker cost scales linearly per identity and forfeits accrued quota on failure.
